Counsel for Petitioner New Prime, Inc.

TO THE HONORABLE STEPHEN BREYER, ASSOCIATE JUSTICE OF THE 
SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES AND CIRCUIT JUSTICE FOR 
THE FIRST CIRCUIT: 

Pursuant  to  Rule  30.3,  Petitioner  New  Prime,  Inc.,  respectfully  requests  a 

seven-day  extension  of  time  in  which  to  file  its  reply  brief  on  the  merits  to  and 

including August 24, 2018.  

1. 

On June 8, 2018, Respondent Dominic Oliveira filed a motion requesting 

a seven-day extension of time to file his response brief in addition to the thirty-day 

extension previously granted by the Clerk of the Court on March 9, 2018.  New Prime 

consented to the additional extension and, in turn, Oliveira consented to the present 

application for an equal extension of time for New Prime to file its reply brief.  The 

Clerk of the Court granted Oliveira’s motion on June 20, 2018.   

2. 

Oliveira  filed  his  response  brief  on  July  18,  2018.    New  Prime’s  reply 

brief is currently due to be filed on August 17, 2018.   

3. 

The  undersigned  counsel  of  record  is  principally  responsible  for 

preparing New Prime’s reply brief.  Mr. Boutrous has other obligations in this period 

for which he is lead counsel and principally responsible, including an approximately 

three-week  trial  beginning  on  July  30,  2018,  in  Pico  Neighborhood  Ass’n  v.  City  of 

Santa Monica, No. BC616804 (Cal. Super. Ct.); a mediation in In re Yahoo! Customer 

Data Security Breach Litigation, No. 16-MD-02752-LHK (N.D. Cal.), the first day of 

which is scheduled for August 14, 2018; an opening brief in Bahamas Surgery Center, 

LLC v. Kimberly-Clark Corp., No. 18-55478 (9th Cir.), due to be filed on August 22, 

2018; and a petition for a writ of certiorari in Kimberly-Clark Corp. v. Davidson, No. 

18A33, due to be filed on September 6, 2018.    

4.   New  Prime’s  requested  seven-day  extension  of  time  will  not  prejudice 

the Court or the parties, given that oral argument has been set for October 3, 2018. 

5. 

Counsel for Oliveira has no objection to this request.

Respectfully submitted, 

Date:  July 25, 2018 

/s/ Theodore J. Boutrous Jr. 
THEODORE J. BOUTROUS JR. 
   Counsel of Record

owned company.
